preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[v] <= 10**9 for v in range(1, N + 1))
preconditions.description: Each element of the array A must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= N for v in range(1, N + 1))
preconditions.description: Each vertex index in the queries must be between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(vis[u] for u in subtree_of_v) % (10**9 + 7))
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query, the output must be the sum of vis[u] for all u in the subtree of v, modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: vis[u] == 0 for u in range(1, N + 1)
postconditions.description: After each type 2 query, all vis[u] must be reset to 0 before running the dfs algorithm.

invariants.expression: vis[v] >= 0 for v in range(1, N + 1)
invariants.description: The visibility count for each vertex must always be non-negative.

invariants.expression: A[v] >= 1 for v in range(1, N + 1)
invariants.description: The value of A[v] must always be at least 1 after any updates.
